build_detection_train_loader: build a detection training data loader from a config with dataset names and sampler settings
build_detection_test_loader: build a detection test data loader with a custom mapper and inference sampler for evaluation
create_DatasetFromList: create a DatasetFromList wrapping a list of dicts with an optional custom serialize method
